title: Delete or wire in the dead scheduler PaceIndicator/ProjectedCompletionText widget file
why: Grepping lib/ for `PaceIndicator(` and `ProjectedCompletionText(` shows the scheduler version is instantiated nowhere in production code — only its own dedicated widget test (pace_indicator_test.dart) exercises it. The app's real pace indicator on curriculum_progress_screen.dart uses a DIFFERENT, differently-shaped `PaceIndicator` class from features/progress/presentation/widgets/pace_indicator.dart (different constructor: `pace`+`subtitleCaption` vs `paceStatus`). Two same-named top-level classes (AG-4 duplicate) strongly suggests the scheduler one was superseded and simply never deleted, along with its fully-passing but functionally pointless test file.
recommendation: Delete lib/features/scheduler/presentation/widgets/pace_indicator.dart and its test, or if a scheduler-local pace badge is genuinely still wanted, rename the class to avoid the AG-4 collision and wire it into a screen.
acceptance_criteria: Only one public `PaceIndicator` class exists in lib/, or the two are clearly distinctly named.
No orphaned widget file with zero production call sites remains.
